title: Capstone Design Project; Electric Guitar Design
description:
Prerequisites: ENEE205, ENEE245, ENEE303, ENEE307. Electrical or Computer Engineering majors in their final year of their program. Restriction: Permission of Electrical & Computer Engineering Department required.

Modern electric guitars contain both EE and CE components; the fundamentals are EE-based, but an increasing number of current designs incorporate CE-based concepts such as active digital control circuits, digital signal processors, and many embedded digital effects units. This class will teach the skills necessary for good product design and development in the real world, using as a motivating example the electric guitar, and integrating computer-engineering skills and concepts.
